head.title: About me section
head.subtitle: Get to know the mind at work.

about.description: Taha Desu, a full-stack engineer with 7+ years of building stuff with React, TypeScript, Node and Express, across retail, healthcare AI and consumer mobile apps. Along the way, I rebuilt a 10,000+ product catalogue in React so filtering feels instant (under 100ms), bumped test coverage by 40%, and took an AI diagnostic pipeline from ~5s down to 1.3s. I'm big on code reviews, I work well with all kinds of teams, and I'm happy running solo in English-speaking teams too.

questions.title: Are you available to work in Japan?
questions.message: Yes, I'm relocating to Japan and can start within one month. I do require visa sponsorship, so I'm looking for companies that are open to sponsoring international engineers.

questions.title: What is your main tech stack?
questions.message: I'm a full-stack engineer focused on React, TypeScript and Node.js/Express. On the frontend I work with Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS and Vite. On the backend I build REST APIs and serverless functions backed by MySQL, MongoDB and Redis. I also write tests with Vitest and have experience integrating AI services into production applications.

questions.title: Which languages do you work in?
questions.message: I work comfortably in English (C2) and French (C1), and I've spent 7+ years in English-language engineering teams. I'm currently at JLPT N4 in Japanese and studying toward N3. I've also built Japanese/English i18n into my projects to get hands-on with localization.

questions.title: What are you most proud of building?
questions.message: At Marjane, I led the React refactor of a catalogue that filters 10,000+ SKUs in under 100ms and raised automated test coverage by 40%. At CY Cergy Paris University, I cut an AI diagnostic pipeline's response time from about 5s to 1.3s. Earlier, at OPPO, I built the Auto Pixelate privacy feature that shipped to millions of devices. You can see my personal projects, including an HR dashboard and a hospitality booking platform, in the Projects section.
